issue: An older loadedWorlds completion overwrites then removes the newer active session, permanently preventing its pending chance refresh.
scenario: Root independent JUnit proof: request A holds loadedWorlds; newer request B opens the list and loot page with pending cache. A completes, sessions.put(A) replaces B before openTracked refuses the stale epoch; remove(A) leaves no registered session. Cache publishes, current B still shows calculating: expected one in-place update, actual zero. 2-test proof run15s, this case failed at expected1/actual0 with no errors.
basis: Issue112: a page open while chances were not ready refreshes in place when they arrive if the same player still has that page open. ADR0010 single-operation state and task stale-page guard. The current B page is still physically open, and refusing stale A must not unregister it.

issue: Negative-weight always-included content shows calculating until the cache finishes although its always status is already known.
scenario: Root held-async real ConfigLoader/WikiMenu test with one weight-1 entry opens its loot page before cache job runs. Lore is Chance:calculating... Amount:1, not Always included. Independent JUnit proof fails assertTrue(Always), no errors. Cache is not required to determine that negative weight means always.
basis: Issue112: content lore uses menu_wiki_content_always for an entry below weight zero; pending entries keep always-included last. Parent106 and ADR0018 negative-weight entries are always included. Root review focus explicitly retains always status without a calculating placeholder.
